ns2:section.sectionText: Both lecture and discussions begin on Monday, August 28, 2017. MCB 252 discussion sections will not meet the week of Sept. 4, 2017. Examinations will be held on Tuesday evenings from 7:00-9:00 pm on September 26, October 17, and November 14, 2017. Students who enter the University Fall 2011 or later are responsible for additional course-based tuition of $300 unless they are already paying differential tuition during the term of course enrollment. This course-based tuition is assessed on and non-refundable after the 10th day of class.
